name: Adaptive Ray Marching with Dynamic Step Count
aliases: CUDA Ray Marching with Adaptive Step Count
definition: An adaptive ray marching algorithm that iteratively samples rays until all are occluded or a max step count is reached, using a density grid for acceleration.
summary: Adaptive Ray Marching with Dynamic Step Count is an iterative volume rendering algorithm that dynamically adjusts the number of steps per ray based on the count of currently active rays.
